name: Hua Hsu Advanced Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hua Hsu Advanced Technology Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the innovation, production, and commercialization of electroplated diamond wires. Their product line features items such as silicon reclaim, test wafers, and epi wafers. The company first began operations on December 23, 2015, and its main office is situated in Taichung City, Taiwan.
